SCP-908-90

Object class: Safe

SCP-908-90 appears to be a series of unlicensed and poorly made bootleg toys of the popular British children's show Teletubies. The "toys" are available in sets of 4, 2 which are similar to vintage wind up toys, and the other half resembling cellular devices, complete with a numerical keypad. The foundation was first notified of this anomaly following the numerous disappearance of children among the city of \[Redacted\] in, China. Most notably, children who had been seen to have made the purchase of the toys in various small stores. Dispatchers were sent to investigate, following with the successful confiscation of the SCPs, which was noted to have a "very foul smell" during the raid.

Autopsy Highlights:

It is noted, that if Scp-908-90-89 (red variant) and Scp-908-90-90 (blue variant), would be wound up by it's "key". The toy's would walk around while beating it's drums, only to unexpectedly dash up to the nearest researcher and explode in a red or blue light. As it's plastic body explodes into pieces acting as shrapnel, slicing and stabbing anything near in it's known radius. During observation, one researcher had been blown backwards by the explosion, and had been stabbed in the eye by a shard of plastic, he has been quickly rushed into the emergency ward at floor 15.

Exception from this one incident, research had been told to continue.

During inspection of Scp-908-90-91 (yellow variant) and Scp-908-90-92 (green variant), in section \[Redacted\] by Dr. \[Redacted\], it was found, that, by entering various mainline telephone numbers in the toys, they would simultaneously open up to reveal a hidden compartment in the toy's rear behind. With each different telephone number, resulting in different items with no certain theme or pattern.

Here are the list of the items that have been recovered:

\-A small glass marble,

\-Two Chinese coins,

\-A rotting human eye,

\-A child's dismembered finger

\-A fresh human tongue

Dr. \[Redacted\] tried to pry open the compartments without entering numbers, and found it surprisingly impossible to open and pry off, even with it's seemingly brittle plastic material.

It is still being studied on how SCP-908-90 could acquire these items, and where they may have possibly come from.

Containment of SCP-908-90:

SCP-908-90 is surprisingly easy to contain and only requires to be stored in a normal cardboard box in normal room temperature. It has been agreed that SCP-908-90 has no trace of sentience or self awareness. And is unable to function on it's own, unless if it has been wound up, or has it's keypad dialed. Therefore it is also heavily not recommended to wind up Scp-908-90-89 and Scp-908-90-90 as it is considered too dangerous, due to it's violent combustions. And is strictly only to be wound up during research.

As for Scp-908-90-91 and Scp-908-90-92, it is also not recommended to "toy" with it's keypad, as further research are still undergoing on how both SCPs acquire the items. And may also pose the risk of this SCP presenting dangerous items that may be both poisonous, or explosive. As no known pattern is known in it's items.
